purpose: Verify public GitHub automation security requirements before implementation
policy_decision: Owner-approved repair; public research only; no code, private project documents or credentials submitted
query: Using the selected GitHub primary references only, explain requirements and failure cases for public-repository automation: independent review versus bot acknowledgement, exact commit binding, PR-controlled workflow check spoofing, required-check publisher identities, untrusted code and secret isolation, minimum permissions, merge commits, auto-merge, and subsequent CI after bot pushes. Identify anything the sources do not establish; cite supporting passages.
approval: Standing project authorization for relevant public reference sources; verified room for two entries.
